intro.text: A senator's daughter and full member of the Dreamwatch from Nagadan, who leads a team of painters that includes Hikiri.

items.text: When Nikaro reached the Dreamwatch's temporary headquarters in Kilahito to warn of an army of nightmares, Tesuaka did not take him seriously. She had Hikiri take his statement and send him away, offering the hollow encouragement that he might be good enough for the Dreamwatch one day.
Once the Dreamwatch was disbanded, Tesuaka had to look for other work.
